THE STORY
First game under the new name, and Mid Ice Crisis opened Fall 2026 the way King Cobras closed Summer: beating the Puckaneers. This is the same team we knocked out 2-1 in the August playoffs, and the all-time series is now 5-1.

- Scoreless first period, then the power play did the work. Killeen from Shortreed and Tadros at 10:05 of the second, Mayor from Chase at 1:47 -- both with a Puckaneer in the box.
- The second period got chippy: coincident roughing minors at 11:38 (Mayor and Roig), plus a Puckaneers cross-check on the same stoppage that handed us the man advantage Killeen cashed in.
- Ryan Smith, from Zimmerman, put it away early in the third. Three goals, three different scorers, five different names on the sheet.
- A 3-0 shutout to start the season. Brad Parker stopped everything the Puckaneers threw -- tag the goals on the box score and we'll get the +/- for this one on the board.

GAME NOTES
- Matthew Killeen scored 1:33 into the power play after Daniel Karmansky's cross-checking.
- Christopher Mayor scored 1:22 into the power play after Derek Lade's tripping.
- Game-winner: Matthew Killeen, 2nd 10:05.
- SHUTOUT: Brad Parker (Mid Ice Crisis).
- All-time vs Puckaneers: 5-1 (goals 17-11).
